133:`mcpjam cloud eval` run-inspection commands (`status`, `cancel`, `judge`, `iterations`, `gate`, `compare`, `trace`, `steps`, `
screenshot`, `video`) follow the same rule — `--project` is optional. `mcpjam cloud sessions list` does too; `--all-projects` rest
ores a cross-project listing and cannot be combined with `--project`. Hosted `readiness` never reads the project link.
141:| `server`, `tools`, `resources`, `prompts` | An **AI client** (`claude`, `chatgpt`, `cursor`, …). The CLI sends that host's `
clientInfo`, capabilities, and protocol version in `initialize`. |
142:| `test --host` | One host **template** to emulate for a local suite run: its handshake, tool visibility and model settings. N
ever the real client. |
144:| `cloud eval --host`, `cloud goals`, `cloud studies` | A **saved project Host** (`<id-or-name>`), the client config an eval o
r goal run is stamped with. |
145:| `cloud environments --host-id` | The project Host id the environment runs as. Distinct from eval's `--host`. |
151:These flags apply to every command. Cloud credentials `--api-key` / `--api-url` are declared on `mcpjam cloud`, not the progra
m root.
168:* **Conformance in CI** — `protocol conformance`, `protocol conformance-suite`, `oauth conformance`, `oauth conformance-suite`
, `apps conformance`, and `apps conformance-suite` support `--reporter junit-xml` and `--reporter json-summary`.
281:If your agent speaks MCP but can't run shell commands (Claude Desktop, chat clients), run the same testing engine as a stdio M
CP server:
